question: Which of the following countries won the first men's Asian Hockey Championship trophy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India won the first men's Asian Hockey Champions Trophy in 2011,** defeating Pakistan in the final via a penalty shootout.
 
• The **Asian Champions Trophy** is a prestigious field hockey tournament held in Asia, showcasing the talent and competitiveness of top Asian hockey nations.
 
• **It was held in 2011**
 
 
• Host: Ordos, China
 
• Participating Teams: India, Pakistan, Malaysia, Japan, South Korea, China
 
• Winner: India
 
 
 
• **India defeated Pakistan in a thrilling penalty shootout**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Asian Champions Trophy is organized by the Asian Hockey Federation (AHF).**
 
• It was f**irst introduced in 2011**, and since then, it has become a key event in the Asian hockey calendar.
 
• T**eams like India, Pakistan, Malaysia, and South Korea are regular participants in the tournament.**
 
• The event helps in improving the competitive standards of Asian teams on the global stage.
 
• Chennai last hosted a major international hockey event in 2007, making the 2023 tournament a significant occasion for the city.
